# `em maint world`

- **Usage:** `em maint world [-f --fix]`

Check (and optionally fix) problems in the world file

## Flags
- **`-f --fix`** — Remove orphaned entries from the world file
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
